releaseNotes:
Instant Favorite Sync: Real-time two-way favorite synchronization across widget, notification bar, and player.
Smooth Album Swipe: Redesigned album art transitions with a synchronized dual-stage carousel.
Auto-Play on Skip: Automatically resumes playback when changing songs while paused.
Volume Boost Smoothing: Parameter smoothing and deferred disk persistence eliminate DSP crackles.
Refined Cellular Icon: Modern 4-bar capsule signal indicator.
